import copy,hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib
P=pathlib.Path('/Users/sb/code/opensip-ai/opensip/docs/coop/completion');s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ci_independent',P/'check_ci_carrier_design.py');M=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(M)
rows=[]
def probe(name,edit,want,paired=False):
 x=copy.deepcopy(M.example);o=copy.deepcopy(M.example);o['changedUnits']=['core/main.rs'];edit(x,o)
 if paired:
  changed=o['changedUnits'];o=copy.deepcopy(x);o['changedUnits']=changed
 before=copy.deepcopy((x,o));out=M.admit(x,o);rows.append({'id':name,'input':x,'trustedObservation':o,'expected':want,'observed':out,'inputUnchanged':before==(x,o),'passed':out==want and before==(x,o)})
c=M.example['currentComponents'][0];u='providers/typescript/provider.ts'
def conflict(x,o):x['currentOwners']['core/main.rs'].append(c)
probe('unobserved-complete-conflict',conflict,'REFUSE')
probe('observed-complete-conflict',conflict,'SELECT-ALL',True)
probe('observed-conflict-plus-empty-untouched-owner',lambda x,o:(conflict(x,o),x['currentOwners'].__setitem__(u,[])),'REFUSE',True)
probe('observed-conflict-plus-unknown-dependency',lambda x,o:(conflict(x,o),x['dependencies'][c].append('99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999')),'REFUSE',True)
probe('observed-conflict-plus-missing-platform-map',lambda x,o:(conflict(x,o),x['platforms'].pop(c)),'REFUSE',True)
probe('observed-conflict-plus-forged-digest',lambda x,o:(conflict(x,o),o['currentOwners']['core/main.rs'].append(c),x.__setitem__('currentRecordDigest','0'*64)),'REFUSE')
probe('deleted-path-previous-conflict',lambda x,o:(x['currentUnits'].remove('core/main.rs'),x['currentOwners'].pop('core/main.rs'),x['previousOwners']['core/main.rs'].append(c)),'SELECT-ALL',True)
probe('source-change-expands-to-untouched-conflict',lambda x,o:(x['currentOwners'][u].append('CORE'),x.__setitem__('currentRecordDigest','0'*64)),'SELECT-ALL',True)
probe('unchanged-source-untouched-conflict',lambda x,o:x['currentOwners'][u].append('CORE'),'ADMIT-TO-SELECTOR',True)
probe('owner-empty-matching-observation',lambda x,o:x['previousOwners'].__setitem__(u,[]),'REFUSE',True)
probe('unknown-owner-matching-observation',lambda x,o:x['currentOwners'].__setitem__(u,['99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999']),'REFUSE',True)
probe('schema-tree-trailing-newline',lambda x,o:x.__setitem__('headTree',x['headTree']+'\n'),'REFUSE',True)
probe('schema-digest-trailing-newline',lambda x,o:x.__setitem__('currentRecordDigest',x['currentRecordDigest']+'\n'),'REFUSE',True)
probe('legal-roleless-observed',lambda x,o:x['roles'].__setitem__(c,[]),'ADMIT-TO-SELECTOR',True)
probe('omitted-previous-component-with-complete-current',lambda x,o:x['previousComponents'].remove(c),'REFUSE')
probe('untouched-owner-forgery',lambda x,o:x['currentOwners'].__setitem__(u,['CORE']),'REFUSE')
probe('unknown-compiled-field',lambda x,o:x.__setitem__('changedUnits',[]),'REFUSE')
r={'passed':sum(i['passed'] for i in rows),'total':len(rows),'probes':rows};pathlib.Path('/tmp/ci-carrier-independent-probes.v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'passed':r['passed'],'total':r['total'],'failures':[i['id'] for i in rows if not i['passed']]}));assert all(i['passed'] for i in rows)

confirmed: The compiled carrier is closed; tree and digest patterns reject trailing newline.

Every previous/current ownership map is compared with trusted observations, including untouched paths. Unit/component sets and dependency, role, platform, consumer and digest custody are checked before SELECT-ALL.
Correctly observed complete conflicts select all. Missing maps, empty owners, unknown references and mismatched source digest refuse even when conflict is present.
Deleted changed paths use previous ownership; a source-record digest change expands the conflict scan to all previous/current units.
An observed empty role list is admitted as the intended roleless build sentinel; a caller cannot silently remove an observed role.

The source-record path is .opensip-ci-ownership.json. Previous/current digest denotes SHA-256 of that exact source blob, not recursively the compiled carrier. Production must acquire the source record and complete Git tree independently.
preconditions: observed is trusted verifier output, including complete tree/component inventories and changedUnits, not caller-supplied assertions.
Ownership maps and record digests in observed must already be tied to exact independently acquired Git source bytes; this narrow model does not perform that acquisition.
Dependency/consumer/role/platform observations are independently acquired from their pinned sources before this function is invoked.
limitations: Carrier validation is reference-model design evidence, not Git acquisition, strict raw JSON parsing, release-signature verification, selector execution or native CI qualification.
Full selector fixed-point selection and six result slots remain the separately reviewed selector/qualification design unit.
No subject/register edit, automatic acceptance/SATISFIED, or product qualification.
